name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: RichTextBlock text/link segmenty v aktivnim Direct2D paint scope kresli pres DirectWrite fast path, GDI TextOutW zustava jen fallback a render-backend smoke hlida RichTextBlock-only DirectWrite pass.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: RichTextBlock text/link segments paint through the DirectWrite fast path inside an active Direct2D paint scope, GDI TextOutW remains the fallback, and render-backend smoke now guards a RichTextBlock-only DirectWrite pass.
